locked_before: any round-11 native GR00T pressure result was observed
unchanged_from_round10: gr00t_pressure_protocol.json recipe, seed17, 4xA100-80GB routing, 55GiB co-resident reservation per GPU, round-10 published checkpoint16 sources, gr00t-native-diagnostics-v2.sbatch launcher; no PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF or other allocator policy

diagnosis_from_round10_records.not_a_leak: Per-minute learner process GPU peaks over resumed updates17-19 are flat at 15,376-15,418 MiB (nonpaged) vs 15,134-15,246 MiB (paged); no growth before the update20 OOM.
diagnosis_from_round10_records.capacity_edge: At OOM on GPU0: reservation 55.48GiB, rollout worker 7.08GiB, simulator 1.15GiB, learner 15.06GiB of 79.33GiB; free 8.88MiB; learner torch-allocated 11.99GiB plus 767.91MiB reserved-unallocated (fragmented) when a 32MiB request failed.
diagnosis_from_round10_records.why_paged_passes: Paged moments (811,696,128 bytes per rank) are managed allocations the driver can evict under oversubscription; nonpaged moments must stay resident, leaving ~0.5GiB less learner headroom.
shared_device_overheads_found: JointPPOTrainer.train_batch held a device clone of every local model shard (~0.8GB BF16 per rank) through all microbatch forward/backward passes, only to verify both parameter groups changed.
The FP32-master optimizer held consumed FP32 gradient staging (~1.6GB per rank) from the step until the next window's zero_grad (through weight sync, rollout and target preparation).

intervention: Shared, optimizer-independent: host-resident pre-update snapshot (bit-identical update norms) and release of consumed FP32 staging after the backend step. Adds per-rank allocator receipts and CUDA-event backend-step time to each window record.

runs_in_order.name: eightbit55-resume16-r11v1
runs_in_order.hypothesis_A: With the shared overheads removed, nonpaged 8-bit completes 16->32 under the unchanged 55GiB pressure.
runs_in_order.falsified_if: Any OOM or stall before checkpoint32 publication. Then the remaining failure is the documented capacity edge; no allocator-policy retry is admitted without a separate predeclared policy row.

runs_in_order.name: paged55-resume16-r11v1
runs_in_order.purpose: Matched-settings comparison partner for nonpaged on the same source: per-update update_seconds and optimizer_backend_step_ms.

runs_in_order.name: paged55-profile-cudaonly-r11v1
runs_in_order.mode: profile, 8 updates, same capture window as round 10
runs_in_order.hypothesis_B: The round-10 instrumented stall is caused by CUPTI unified-memory fault tracing; with PROFILE_VARIANT=cuda_only the instrumented run completes all 8 updates.
runs_in_order.falsified_if: The cuda_only run also stalls in backward; then the stall is not attributable to UM fault tracing and remains open.

conditional: fused55 fresh control only if A passes (to test whether the same changes move fused past its round-10 update-2 OOM); it is not required for A or B.
measurement_scope: Paging overhead is reported as matched-pressure paged minus nonpaged backend-step device time and update-phase seconds on one seed and one node each; it is a single-run observation, not a sustained-speed or end-to-end time-to-quality claim. If nonpaged fails A, no matched pressure comparison exists and only the paged numbers are reported.
